examples.title: Content card
examples.description: The display title is Card. The UiCard names, ui-card module and CLI key remain unchanged.

examples.title: All variants
examples.description: default, template, icon, action and metrics remain available. Use MetricCard for a focused new metric summary.

examples.title: Selectable card
examples.description: Supplying onClick adds keyboard activation, button semantics and a calm hover border. selected and disabled retain their meaning.

examples.title: Independent footer action
examples.description: Keep a content card passive when it contains links or buttons. Its footer supports a byline and action.

examples.title: Responsive widths
examples.description: className can adapt the retained default widths. w-full and a maximum keep the card inside the page.

examples.title: Existing metrics composition
examples.description: The metrics variant and the six original parts remain usable when only the import path changes.
